prompt:
ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down at the object's TOP SURFACE ONLY. Rectangular edges run horizontally and vertically on the canvas. Show no vertical front or side faces.

Create an ORIGINAL game vehicle sprite for the D'thorga flatbed trailer: a two-axle flatbed trailer with low sides and a drawbar, towed behind a truck to carry a second load for a hard-scrabble frontier colony. Image 1 is our approved truck from the same family: match its outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT copy its shape or layout, and draw no cab and no engine.

Draw the BARE EMPTY TRAILER only. Taller side boards are drawn separately as an overlay.

Tall canvas, twice as tall as wide. The trailer is LONG AND NARROW: its deck is about one third as wide as the trailer is long, and its wheels stick out a little beyond the deck on each side. It fills seven eighths of the canvas height, centred, on a plain pure white background. North facing: the drawbar at the TOP edge, the rear of the deck at the BOTTOM edge.

Its plan, from top to bottom: at the top, a triangular A-frame drawbar of dark steel narrowing to a round towing eye at its tip; then a short raised headboard across the front of the deck with one muted orange accent stripe; then one long flat rectangular deck of dark weathered steel planks running lengthways, edged all round by low pale sand-grey side boards; the tops of four wheels with dark rubber tyres, two each side, close together as a tandem pair just behind the middle of the deck, each pair under a pale sand-grey mudguard; at the bottom, a plain rear board with two small square corner posts.

Style: a top-down sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, pale panels, rounded corners, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No cab, engine, seats, tall side boards, stakes, straps, chains, cargo, crates, people, animals, turrets, ramps, dust, mud, damage, text, letters, numbers, logos, dials, screens or lamps. No floor, ground, road, shadow outside the trailer, perspective, tilt or visible side faces. Top surfaces only.
